purpose: First-party facts from Grace Company documents, compared against data/specs/grace-qnique-19x.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file. Values are as printed, with units. Manual page numbers are PDF pages (printed page numbers run 2 lower).

documents.note: Redirects to the Grace home page. The base 19X no longer has a new-machine product page or a shop listing; the 19X Elite, 16X, 16X Elite, 21X Elite, 19SD and Little Rebel are listed instead.
Only live Grace page for the base 19X. Carries features, box contents and the maker's own 19X vs 19X Elite and 19X vs 16X answers.

documents.type: product page with a 19X vs 19X Elite comparison table
documents.note: Table lists the 19X at 2000 spm with a 2.4 in color touchscreen and $5,999.00 against $8,899.95 struck through.
No new 19X in the machine list; Recertified Grace 19X is $4,999.00 against $5,999.00.
Lists Q'nique 19X under the 2 Year and 5 Year Limited Warranties and Q'nique 19X Elite under the 10 Year.
Text extracted with pymupdf; cached locally, not committed. Titled Q'nique 19 X Instruction Manual.
Downloaded, not read; parts diagram only.

facts.value: 19 in (482.6 mm) quilting arm width; quilting arm height 8.9 in (224.8 mm)
facts.note: The manual gives arm height 8.9 in, which fills throatHeightIn (null in spec). The Elite page's 'blocks up to 15 in' and the recertified page's 'block size up to 17 in' are block sizes, not throat.

site.label: Throat
site.grace: 19 in arm width, 8.9 in arm height (manual).
site.others: Dealers say 19 in. One Grace page says blocks up to 17 in, another up to 19 in; block size is not throat space.

facts.value: 8.9 in (224.8 mm) quilting arm height
2000 spm; range 90 to 2000 spm

site.label: Speed
site.grace: 90 to 2000 stitches per minute (manual). The Elite is 2600.

facts.value: 41.5 lb (18.8 kg) body; body 26.8 in high, 15.6 in wide, 32.8 in long (680.2 x 395.4 x 831.9 mm)

site.label: Weight and body size
site.grace: 41.5 lb (18.8 kg). Body 26.8 high x 15.6 wide x 32.8 long in.
site.others: No dealer page found lists weight.

facts.value: Peak power consumption 300 W; input 110-220 VAC (nominal 120 V circuit per safety page)
facts.note: Peak consumption is not a motor rating. The motor itself is not described.

facts.value: 2.4 in color touch display (manual and Grace pages); the 19X Elite has a 7 in display
facts.source: grace-19x-manual PDF p.9, p.15; grace-19x-recert; grace-19x-elite-page
facts.spec_value: Full color OLED touchscreen (19X); 7 in touchscreen on the 19X Elite
facts.note: Spec cites a dealer for 'OLED'. Grace and its manual say 2.4 in color touch display and never say OLED. Use the Grace wording.

site.label: Screen
site.others: Dealer copy says 'full color OLED touchscreen'; Grace does not.

facts.value: Approved needle styles DPX5 MR, 134 MR, 1955 MR; sizes 14 to 20 listed; manual says change needle after 8 hours of use

site.label: Needle
site.grace: DPX5 MR, 134 MR or 1955 MR (multi-directional); size 16 for 60 wt, size 18 for 50 wt polyester.
site.others: Dealers list only the included sizes 16 and 18.

facts.value: 10 size 16 and 10 size 18 needles (one size 18 pre-installed)
M class; 3 bobbins in the box (two pre-installed, pre-wound with 50 wt polyester Finesse); built-in bobbin winder with auto shut-off
facts.source: grace-19x-manual PDF p.15, p.48, p.9; grace-19x-recert
facts.note: The 19X manual lists a built-in bobbin winder (with automatic stop) and a dual thread mast. The spec's dealer source treats the built-in winder as an Elite addition. Maker document wins; the dealer version is kept as the disagreement.

site.label: Bobbin winder
site.grace: Built-in winder with automatic stop (19X manual).
site.others: Dealer copy treats the built-in winder as an Elite feature.

facts.value: Regulated stitching; four stitch modes (Manual, Cruise, Precise, Baste); Edge Warning; measuring tool; bobbin estimator
facts.spec_value: Built in; encoders read carriage movement and set motor speed
facts.note: Spec had straight stitch only plus manual mode; Grace lists four modes.

facts.value: No automatic top-thread trimmer described. A built-in thread cutter on the hopping foot cuts excess thread after threading; a bobbin-thread cutter sits on the winder
facts.note: An owner thread (quiltingboard t298173) mentions an automatic thread cutter firing on a Q'nique; the 19X manual does not describe one, so that thread is not credited to the 19X.

facts.value: One hopping foot with height tool and screw in the box; a 3-piece hopping foot set ($127.46) and ruler or 360 Wonder foot are separate accessories
facts.source: grace-19x-manual PDF p.15, p.17; grace-19x-recert (Frequently bought together)
facts.spec_value: Hopping foot; 20 needles; dealer bonus kits vary and are not manufacturer box contents

facts.value: Machine, 3 M class bobbins, size 18 x10 and size 16 x10 needles, machine oil, sample thread kit, basic maintenance tools (Allen wrenches, lint brush, needle magnet, screwdriver, timing spacer tool), 2.4 in display, handlebar assembly, thread stand, encoders, wheel base and covers
facts.note: The machine has wheel bases, so it is not a table-top head: it ships with an encoder install and wheel-base assembly for a frame.

facts.value: Not included in the machine price. Recertified listing offers frame choices as add-ons: Cutie tabletop (+$999.95), Q-Zone Hoop-Frame (+$1,799.95), Q-Zone Queen (+$2,199.95), Q-Zone Queen Pro (+$3,099.90), Quilter's Evolution Hoop-Frame (+$3,299.95), Quilter's Evolution Elite 8, 10 or 12 ft (+$4,499.95). Listed machine pairings: Q'nique 15, 16 or 19 series
facts.spec_value: Sold machine only or bundled; fits all Grace frames including Cutie, Q-Zone Hoop, Q-Zone Queen and Continuum
facts.note: Seen on the Grace recertified listing, 2026-10-02; Continuum frames are not offered in that list. Not a binding price.

facts.value: Oil after 20 hours of use, at the start of each project and after 30 days unused; hook assembly every other bobbin change; the System Info screen carries an Hours Run counter

site.label: Oiling
site.grace: After 20 hours of use, at project start and after 30 days idle; hook every other bobbin change.

facts.value: 2 yr limited (Q'nique 19X) and 5 yr limited on the cast metal body. Warranty page also lists 'All Grace Qnique Quilting Machine Electronic Parts' at 2 yr. The 19X Elite carries 10 yr on the cast body
facts.spec_value: 5 yr cast body, 2 yr mechanical parts, 1 yr electrical parts, original owner (dealer statement of Grace warranty)
facts.note: The spec's dealer statement says 1 yr electrical; Grace's own page puts electronic parts at 2 yr. Warranty is the original owner only and does not transfer. The shipping and box-return conditions are the owner's. Direct purchases only carry a 30 day money-back guarantee; dealer sales do not.

site.label: Warranty
site.grace: 2 yr limited on the machine and its electronic parts; 5 yr on the cast metal body; original owner only. (19X Elite: 10 yr cast body.)
site.others: Grace dealer page says 5 / 2 / 1 yr (casting, mechanical, electrical).

facts.value: Recertified 19X $4,999.00 (valued $5,999.00); 19X Elite $7,999.00 (list $9,499.95); 19X compare-table price $5,999.00 against $8,899.95 struck through
facts.note: The base 19X has no new-machine product page. Prices are Grace's own, seen 2026-10-02, and shown only in the Last seen line.

facts.value: The base Grace 19X is not in Grace's current new-machine lineup (19X Elite, 16X, 16X Elite, 21X Elite, 19SD, Little Rebel). Grace still sells it recertified, still lists it in the 19X Elite comparison table, and still publishes the 19X manual
facts.note: Grace does not say the 19X is discontinued. We cannot call it discontinued; the spec's discontinued flag stays as is.

site.label: Availability
site.grace: No new 19X listing on graceframe.com; recertified units and the Elite comparison page remain.

facts.value: 'A level of quality in precision stitching ... never available before in such an affordable package' appears on the Grace 19X Elite page meta description; 'the 19X will not hold anyone back' is Grace's 19X vs Elite FAQ
facts.note: Marketing language; quote as a claim.

facts.value: Lamp above the needle area switched on or off from the touch display; the manual describes no dimming
facts.note: Dealer pages (Moore's, Tops) say the 19X needle light dims; Grace's 19X Elite page lists 'dimmable LED lights' as an Elite feature. The 19X manual says on or off only. Treat dimming as unconfirmed for the 19X.

site.label: Needle light
site.grace: On or off from the touch display (manual); dimming is listed for the 19X Elite.
site.others: Dealer copy for the 19X says the needle light dims.
